final: WITH g AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(s.scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(s.gbsize)*1.0/SUM(s.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM g) SELECT g.status, g.total_scans, g.rate, g.rate - a.avg_rate AS diff FROM g, a WHERE g.rate > a.avg_rate
